values.note: 98 RV-only sites with water and 20/30/50-amp electric (an RV or pop-up required; ReserveAmerica lists them at 40 ft), 5 tent-only sites, and a safari field for RV clubs (20-75 self-contained units). Hookups are shared and some sit far from the pad: DCR says bring 50-75 ft of extension cord and hose. One camping vehicle per site; no charcoal, propane cooking only.

summary: Filled from ReserveAmerica + mass.gov: 98 RV-only sites with water + 20/30/50-amp electric (40 ft listed), 5 tent sites and an RV-club safari field (count 103), dump (reserved campers, 8-3) and showers, reservations required, 14-day cumulative limit; shared hookups need 50-75 ft cord/hose. Fees $22/$70 + $4 water + $6 electric and the 2026 season 4/9-11/21 (self-contained only in the shoulder) confirmed - the $2 Trust surcharge is the Acts 2014 c.88 Scusset Beach State Reservation Trust Fund levy on every camping fee, residents included (proposed fees.note in flags). Pull-through not stated (RA gives no driveway type for most sites) - left unset. Coastal dunes kept (--AWH firsthand; RA 'Situated at the corner of Cape Cod Bay and the east end of scenic Cape Cod Canal'; the loops sit beside the canal with the dune field to the NE). --AWH note kept verbatim. Pin is ~220 m NW of the loops' centre (41.7773,-70.5031) - within tolerance.

Fees note (manual 2026-09-20, not overwritten) - proposed text: "MA DCR publishes this campground's rate by name: $22 a night for a Massachusetts resident, $70 for everyone else. Hookups are priced separately: water $4 and electric $6 a night at every RV site, plus a $2-a-night Scusset Beach Trust surcharge - a state law (Acts 2014, ch. 88) adds $2 to every camping, admission and parking fee here for the reservation's long-term upkeep, so residents pay it too. Out-of-state is the charge to plan for - it is the camping rate, not a gate fee, so no pass avoids it. Add $4.50 per reservation (not per night); no entrance fee for campers." Source: https://www.mass.gov/info-details/camping-fees ('Scusset Beach State Reservation $22 $70 ... water $4, electric $6, Trust Surcharge $2') + https://massdcrcamping.reserveamerica.com/camping/scusset-beach-state-reservation/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MA&parkId=32620 ('$22 for MA resident / $70 non-resident; PLUS $4 water and $6 electric hookups at all RV sites; PLUS $2 surcharge to benefit the Scusset Beach Trust Fund') + https://malegislature.gov/Laws/SessionLaws/Acts/2014/Chapter88 ('DCR shall impose a surcharge of $2 upon each fee charged and collected from admission into, camping in and parking in the Scusset Beach State Reservation'), read 2026-10-28.
